stories.text: 🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: 49er Faith-Fool vs Ramosverse. Playoff odds with a win / loss: 49er Faith-Fool 72% / 48%, Ramosverse 17% / 5.2%.
⚡ Early edge: Ruffing the Passer went from 38% to 59% against The Mahomies, led by Hubbard (24.90 pts).
🎯 TWO WINS: 49er Faith-Fool: 75% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 45% with none (now 64%).
📈 LINE MOVE: PHI @ WSH: PHI −2.5 at open, WSH −6 now. 6 league starters in it, led by J. Daniels (TDsMaGee).
🎟️ RAFFLE WATCH: Brock You Like a Hurricane (28% to take the ticket) is chasing Ruffing the Passer's 69.62 — 51.32 pts back with 9 starters still to play.
🗓️ Sunday's key matchup: Mr. Action Jackson 51% vs Kyle Tucker. Kyle Tucker leads by 17.30 after TNF. Watch Nacua (22.87 pts) vs Irving (17.64 pts).
🪑 The one that got away (on the bench): TDsMaGee has started RJ Harvey just once. Starting him in Weeks 1, 3, 4 and 6 would have meant 3 more wins by now.
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Mel's Mediocre Mob leads the chopping-block odds at 46%, with In My Fantasy Era next at 24%.
📰 Packers' Josh Jacobs: TD celebration was ode to gospel song, not mocking arrest. That's Ruffing the Passer's starting RB. Take note.
🕰️ Hindsight swap: If Ramosverse and Brock You Like a Hurricane had swapped Washington and McBride for Bowers and Watson back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
👀 League gossip: Ruffing the Passer has 48.72 pts to play with against The Mahomies.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 22% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
